== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eternity]] Incorporated is a malevolent organization that functions more like a cult than a traditional business. Its members are driven by deep devotion to the group's mission, which involves using modern science to fulfill ancient religious myths regarding the creation of a flawless monster capable of transforming the world. The entity's primary expertise lies in the development and enhancement of monsters, including the ability to manipulate hive-minds. Identified by a [[rainbow spiral symbol]] and operating out of white spires, the corporation sought to expand its influence globally through a massive final project. Although the organization is eventually destroyed, its legacy persists as various competing groups struggle to claim its dangerous research to create their own world-altering creatures.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Originally established as a local religion, [[Eternity]] Incorporated evolved into an organization that operated more like a cult than a traditional corporation. The entity's headquarters featured a central spire marked with a [[rainbow spiral symbol]], and its workers were identifiable by white uniforms bearing the same emblem. While the group claimed its goal was to improve monsters, it was actually an evil corporation engaged in dangerous research. During investigations into incidents at their headquarters, a new consciousness began to stir within the building's basement. Ultimately, [[Eternity]] Incorporated did not survive.}}
